name: Parbo Resources Ltd.
summary: Parbo Resources Limited operates as a mineral exploration and development company in Australia. The company primarily explores for gold and copper. Its projects include the Mount Padbury Project, consisting of 8 tenements, that covers approximately 765 square kilometers located within the Murchison Mineral GoldField ; and the Bryah Project, consisting of 13 tenements, that covers approximately 461 square kilometers in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. Parbo Resources Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
